en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large mid‑20th‑century ocean liner moored in a busy industrial harbor. The ship has two prominent funnels with circular badges on them, multiple lifeboats along the upper decks, and traditional cargo masts and kingposts. Cranes and port infrastructure line the distant quayside under a partly cloudy sky. The scene focuses on the ship in profile with calm water in the foreground.
